connectors.name: 2 contact pins on the back of the enclosure
connectors.orderNote: No pin-1 mark and no USB connector visible; vertical pair ordered top to bottom.

notes: The only physical contacts shown are two round contacts on the back of the enclosure, with moulded letters beside them (read as R top, B bottom, printed rotated). All other text is peripheral GPIO tables given as (port, pin) pairs, not wiring points. The four holes at the bottom of the back are not labelled.
uncertain: back-contacts: the moulded letters are rotated and low-contrast; read as R and B but could be other glyphs. Their function (likely a charging/accessory contact pair) is not stated in the image, and they may be a power-only connector that rule 1 would skip.
